name: Stove-Side Hearth Tea Preparation Kit
marketing_tip: Gather around the warmth of the hearth with this complete kit for authentic roasted tea.
body: This set includes a traditional clay pot and accessories designed for brewing tea over an open flame or charcoal. It's the perfect way to create a cozy, interactive tea experience for friends and family during cold evenings.
